msg: There seems to be a pattern where picking a blue or red gnome will allow you to pick up many mushrooms a lot of the time but as soon as you start picking no mushrooms when clicking on the blue or red gnome you need to revert to clicking on the green or brown gnome to pick a alot of mushrooms.  As soon as you collect no or low number of mushrooms when clicking on the green or brown gnome revert back to clicking on the red or blue gnome.  Follow this pattern of clicking these coloured gnomes to increase the number of mushrooms you can pick.
